groups.title: Pump and Motor Repair
groups.summary: The pump is the heart of the system, and it is the component we replace and rebuild most often.
groups.intro: The pump is the heart of the system, and it is the component we replace and rebuild most often. A pump that is loud, leaking at the seal, tripping the breaker, or losing prime is telling you something. Sometimes the fix is a new seal or motor bearing, sometimes a capacitor, and sometimes the unit is past its service life.

about.title: About A-Affordable Pool & Spa Service
text: Since 1991, A Affordable Pool & Spa Svc Inc. has been helping homeowners in Carrollton, TX, and surrounding areas enjoy cleaner, safer, and more beautiful pools. What started as a small local business has grown into one of the most trusted pool service providers in the region—thanks to decades of experience, dedication to quality, and a genuine commitment to customer satisfaction.

Our story is simple: we believe every homeowner deserves a pool that looks great and functions perfectly without the stress of constant maintenance or unreliable service. For over 30 years, that philosophy has guided every project we take on, from simple cleanings to full pool renovations.

When A Affordable Pool & Spa Svc Inc. was founded in 1991, the goal was clear—provide dependable pool service at fair prices, with honesty and professionalism leading the way. We saw that too many homeowners were left frustrated by inconsistent service and repairs that didn’t last. So we built our reputation on doing things differently: being thorough, transparent, and standing behind our work every single time.
